source.coordinate_method: Manually transcribed from the Latitude (N), Longitude (E) line; visually checked against each PDF page. No metre-scale registration accuracy inferred.

measurements.name: Swift Run
measurements.reported_assignment: Raman peaks assigned to Fe/Mg carbonate; the report says no other mineral peaks could confidently be identified.

measurements.name: Hazeltop
measurements.reported_assignment: Raman peaks assigned to Mg/Ca sulfates (some weakly hydrated); the report also assigns peaks in sol505 scans to carbonates.

measurements.name: Shuyak
measurements.reported_assignment: Raman peaks assigned to carbonate and sulfate; phosphate is possible, not confirmed.

scope: Reported abrasion-patch measurements near the sample sites, not measurements of an entire36m CRISM pixel. Values are PIXL XRF oxide-equivalent mass fractions as reported, not inferred mineral abundances. No cross-instrument agreement or disagreement inferred.
